dedupe_keys.name: hourly energy demand generation and weather

description: This collection combines four years of hourly electricity demand, generation by source, prices and weather for Spain. The contributor identifies ENTSO-E as the source of consumption and generation, Red Eléctrica de España as the source of settlement prices, and purchased OpenWeather observations for the five largest Spanish cities. The collection includes operator forecasts for demand and prices so that new forecasting models can be compared with operational forecasts. It explicitly targets hourly and day-ahead demand and price forecasting. Limitations: coverage is national electricity data joined with city weather; exact start and end dates, city names and internal file formats are not stated in the inspected native description. The contributor states CC0 terms. The terms of the constituent providers and any charges or registration needed for payload retrieval were not independently established. The native Kaggle description and metadata API provide the access routes. Related resources: this joined benchmark is distinct from the broad ENTSO-E portal and the separately catalogued Spanish 2007–2019 demand/EV dataset. No files were retrieved.
